import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPowerOpen
import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.RelativePowerGeometricallyReduced

/-!
# Variety properties of symmetric powers

The canonical finite symmetric quotient of a geometrically reduced, separated
scheme of finite type over a field is again a variety. Affine neighborhoods
of finite source subsets supply the quotient construction. This is the
variety-property step of Milne III.3.1; separability of the quotient projection
is a separate assertion.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

open StableGroupAction StableGroupAction.StableAffineOpen

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

/-- A geometrically reduced relative power has a geometrically reduced
canonical symmetric quotient. -/
theorem symmetricPowerQuotient_geometricallyReduced
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [(relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated] [CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (relativePower V n).hom]
    [GeometricallyReduced (relativePower V n).hom]
    (h : OrbitsInAffineOpen (permutationAutHomOverLeft V n)) :
    GeometricallyReduced (symmetricPowerQuotient V n h).hom :=
  finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_geometricallyReduced (quotientPermutationAction V n)
    (relativePower V n).hom (quotientPermutationAction_comp_base V n)
      (quotientPermutationAction_orbits V n h)

/-- An AF variety over any field has a finite surjective symmetric quotient
which is again a variety. The witness is the canonical invariant-ring
construction; its projection has the quotient topology, orbit fibres, the
invariant structure sheaf, and the universal property for symmetric maps. -/
theorem exists_variety_symmetricPowerData
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [QuasiCompact V.hom] [IsSeparated V.hom]
    [GeometricallyReduced V.hom]
    (hV : Scheme.FiniteInAffine V.left) :
    ∃ D : SymmetricPowerData V n,
      LocallyOfFiniteType D.carrier.hom ∧ QuasiCompact D.carrier.hom ∧
        IsSeparated D.carrier.hom ∧ GeometricallyReduced D.carrier.hom ∧
        IsFinite D.projection.left ∧ Surjective D.projection.left ∧
        IsGeometricQuotient (quotientPermutationAction V n) D.projection.left := by
  letI := relativePower_locallyOfFiniteType V n
  letI := relativePower_quasiCompact V n
  letI := relativePower_isSeparated V n
  letI := relativePower_geometricallyReduced V n
  letI : (relativePower V n).left.IsSeparated :=
    (HasAffineProperty.iff_of_isAffine (P := @IsSeparated)
      (f := (relativePower V n).hom)).mp inferInstance
  letI : CompactSpace (relativePower V n).left :=
    QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (relativePower V n).hom
  let h := permutation_orbitsInAffineOpen_of_source_finiteInAffine V n hV
  refine ⟨symmetricPowerDataOfOrbits V n h, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    symmetricPowerQuotient_geometricallyReduced V n h,
    symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isFinite V n h,
    ⟨symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_surjective V n h⟩,
    symmetricPowerQuotientProjection_isGeometricQuotient V n h⟩
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_locallyOfFiniteType (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (relativePower V n).hom (quotientPermutationAction_comp_base V n)
        (quotientPermutationAction_orbits V n h)
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_quasiCompact (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (relativePower V n).hom (quotientPermutationAction_comp_base V n)
        (quotientPermutationAction_orbits V n h)
  · exact finiteStableQuotientBaseMap_isSeparated (quotientPermutationAction V n)
      (relativePower V n).hom (quotientPermutationAction_comp_base V n)
        (quotientPermutationAction_orbits V n h)

end MilneLib
